scientific.integrity: The proof is an all-parameter cyclic-run classification. A standalone finite verifier independently reconstructs the complexes for 3 <= k <= 14 and is used only as a cross-check, not as an infinite proof.
scientific.limitations: The theorem determines the complete face vector and reduced Euler characteristic, but it does not prove the conjectured wedge decomposition or determine attaching maps. The formula for the number of four-spheres is a conditional consequence of that homotopy shape.

title: Face vector and Euler characteristic of the borderline squared-cycle cut complexes
